title: A quinazoline-based bromodomain inhibitor, CN210, ameliorates indomethacin-induced ileitis in mice by inhibiting inflammatory cytokine expression.
authors: Noguchi, Takehisa; Hidaka, Kyosuke; Kobayashi, Satsuki; Matsumoto, Kenjiro; Yoshioka, Makoto; Hu, Xin; Maloney, David J; Yang, Shyh-Ming; Kato, Shinichi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BET溴结构域抑制剂CN210的抗炎作用，涉及蛋白-小分子结合与对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inhibitors of bromodomain and extra-terminal motif (BET) proteins are emerging epigenetic therapeutics that suppress gene expressions that drive cancer and inflammation. The present study examined anti-inflammatory effects of a quinazoline-based BET inhibitor, CN210, in a murine ileitis model. CN210 was given orally 30 min before and 24 h after a subcutaneous administration of indomethacin. Macroscopic and histological evidences of ileitis, mucosal myeloperoxidase (MPO) activity and cytokine expressions were evaluated 48 h after the indomethacin administration. To further characterize the anti-inflammatory pathways modulated by CN210, its effects on RAW264 cells treated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) were investigated. Competitive ligand binding and docking studies of CN210 to CREB-binding protein (CBP) and p300 were also performed. Oral administration of CN210 significantly reduced the severity of ileitis, normalized both proinflammatory MPO activity and concomitant cytokine expressions induced by indomethacin administration. Furthermore, CN210 attenuated the expression of cytokines and reversed the activation of nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) and mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPK) induced by LPS. Competitive ligand binding assays showed that CN210 bound to the bromodomains of two paralogous histone acetyltransferases, CBP and p300, in addition to the bromodomains of BET proteins. Docking studies of CN210 to the bromodomains of CBP and p300 showed a similarity to the binding mode of SGC-CBP30, a specific CBP/p300 inhibitor. CN210 ameliorates indomethacin-induced ileitis by inhibiting the expression of inflammatory cytokines through the attenuation of NF-kappaB and MAPK pathways. CN210 thus represents a new mode of therapy for non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug-induced ileitis and inflammatory bowel disease.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外基序（BET）蛋白抑制剂是新兴的表观遗传治疗药物，可抑制驱动癌症和炎症的基因表达。本研究考察了一种基于喹唑啉的BET抑制剂CN210在小鼠回肠炎模型中的抗炎作用。在皮下注射吲哚美辛前30分钟及后24小时，口服给予CN210。在吲哚美辛给药后48小时，评估回肠炎的宏观和组织学证据、黏膜髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性及细胞因子表达。为进一步表征CN210调节的抗炎通路，研究了其对脂多糖（LPS）处理的RAW264细胞的影响。同时进行了CN210与CREB结合蛋白（CBP）和p300的竞争性配体结合及对接研究。口服CN210显著降低了回肠炎的严重程度，使吲哚美辛诱导的促炎性MPO活性及伴随的细胞因子表达恢复正常。此外，CN210减弱了细胞因子的表达，并逆转了LPS诱导的核因子κB（NF-κB）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）的激活。竞争性配体结合实验显示，CN210除了与BET蛋白的溴结构域结合外，还与两个旁系同源组蛋白乙酰转移酶CBP和p300的溴结构域结合。CN210与CBP和p300溴结构域的对接研究显示，其结合模式与特异性CBP/p300抑制剂SGC-CBP30相似。CN210通过抑制NF-κB和MAPK通路中炎症细胞因子的表达，改善吲哚美辛诱导的回肠炎。因此，CN210代表了非甾体抗炎药诱导的回肠炎和炎症性肠病的一种新型治疗模式。
